summary: Volato Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization with M2i Global, Inc. The merger was required to close by March 31, 2026 (as extended) but did not. Volato terminated under Section 10.1 without incurring any termination fee. The company states it is evaluating strategic alternatives and has received unsolicited letters of intent it believes may provide greater shareholder value. The termination is a no-fault walkaway. The risk-arb angle is moot; the watch item is any potential competing transaction that may now emerge.
